messages:
Raj: quick FYI — we had ~1200 concurrent mobile streams from a single IP this morning and the edge ended up holding sockets for >2m each. client UX timed out but server still had KV cache allocated. I think we need a clear egress connection quota + graceful teardown contract at the gateway. :grimacing:
Mike: ugh. do we know if these were long-running translates or stuck reconnect loops?
Raj: mostly stuck reconnects after flaky mobile NAT. clients kept reissuing long-poll /sse with small backoff, so the edge accumulated.
Sarah: agree this is an operational risk. two options: enforce per-client connection tokens at ingress or rely on downstream (runtime) to evict idle kv caches.
Zach: downside of ingress enforcement is we might drop legitimate long-lived streams for power users. need soft limits + priority.
Anya: can we do a hybrid: per-client soft quota + fast-fail threshold + graceful teardown window? soft quotas return HTTP 429 with Retry-After; fast-fail for new connections when global egress exhausted.
Raj: exactly what I sketched. proposal: 1) token bucket per client-id (api-key / user-id / ip fallback) 2) soft_quota N streams -> 429 with explanatory header 3) when global pool is >90% used, enforce hard_quota and return 503 for new streams 4) introduce STREAM_GRACE_PERIOD to allow active streams to close nicely, after which proxy sends STREAM_TERMINATE (gRPC RST/ SSE close)
Mike: sounds reasonable. what about state explosion for token bookkeeping? we already have millions of short-lived keys.
Raj: keep it approximate in the edge: use a small LRU registry keyed by client-id hashes + TTLs. eviction policy favors long-running tokens so identities with short bursts won't bloat.
Sarah: how do we wire metrics/tracing? need per-decision tags so SRE can see "quota-block", "grace-teardown", "fast-fail". also correlation-id in close reasons.
Raj: yes — headers: `X-Edge-Quota-Reason`, `X-Edge-Quota-Remaining`, and `X-Edge-Trace` on the close event.
Zach: perf impact concerns: adding registry lookups on accept path must be O(1). implement in C++ side of envoy filter; avoid async RPCs to control plane.
Anya: fallback behavior for Dedicated customers? they might want higher limits or bypass. need policy to mark tenants with dedicated_pool:true to skip soft quota checks.
Raj: agreed. config example for the edge (proto-ish):
```
edge_config {
  egress_quota_per_client: 8
  stream_grace_period_ms: 30000
  hard_fail_threshold_pct: 90
  fast_fail_after_ms: 5000
  lru_registry_size: 10000
}
```
Mike: do we need an explicit handshake for long-lived streams so clients can opt-in? maybe `Connection-Mode: long-lived` header and token claim. that avoids false positives.
Raj: good idea. clients that know they'll be long-lived present a signed token with TTL so edge can pre-allocate slot. unsigned connections fall under conservative limits.
infra-bot: observed log snippet from this morning: `edge[proxy] conn_accept ip=1.2.3.4 client_id=unknown duration=120345ms state=idle_kv_allocated`
Zach: thanks. that shows allocated kv is the thing sticking around. with graceful termination we can send close reason and free kv immediately once client receives close. also need a server-side hard timeout on KV cache retention after stream close (e.g., kv_retention_ms = 10000).
Sarah: rollout plan? we should start with telemetry-only mode to count decisions, then soft quota (429), then global hard fail. need 2-week observation windows between steps.
Anya: can we add an escape hatch header for partners to request exemption for migration windows? `X-Edge-Quota-Bypass: token` with HMAC signed by salesops.
Mike: Security note: ensure bypass tokens are short-lived and audited.
Raj: next steps I'll draft a short RFC with config schema, envoy filter sketch, and metrics list. will include test plan for chaos scenarios (mobile NAT flapping, large fanout bots).
Sarah: :thumbsup: please include example dashboards and alert thresholds.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: edge/filters/egress-quota v0.1 -> canary @ prod-us-west at 2024-06-12T02:30Z
Raj: thanks — I'll post RFC link here once ready.
Zach: one last nit — we should document client SDK guidance (exponential backoff + jitter, use Connection-Mode header) so partners don't hit the quota.
Raj: added to RFC checklist. thanks all. :rocket:
